definitions.gloss: to improve; to make progress; to get better at
definitions.explanation: To become more skilled or proficient at something through practice or experience. Used for skills, abilities, and performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上達|じょうたつ}した。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}すれば→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{上達|じょうたつ}する。
examples.english: If you practice every day, you'll definitely improve.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{上達|じょうたつ}しなくて⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: It's been three years since I started piano, but I'm frustrated because I'm not improving much.

notes:
USAGE:
The subject is typically a skill or ability rather than a person. You say 「⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上達|じょうたつ}する」 (Japanese improves) rather than 「⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上達|じょうたつ}する」 (I improve), though the latter is also grammatically possible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{語学|ごがく}→語学：02770_gogaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上達|じょうたつ}する (language skills improve)
- ⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (improvement is fast)
- ⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧ (secret to improvement)
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上達|じょうたつ}する (one's skill improves)
- ⟦めきめき→めきめき：07408_mekimeki⟧{上達|じょうたつ}する (improve rapidly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to advance, to progress — broader; can apply to technology, society, or personal skills
- ⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧: to improve, to elevate — more formal; used for quality, standards, or overall levels
- ⟦{熟達|じゅくたつ}→熟達：15463_jukutatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to master — implies reaching a high level of expertise
